messages:
maria: Heads-up — putting the release train into QUIET MODE for the next 3 hours starting now. We hit a latency pattern on canary shard A; want to throttle traffic and limit new rollouts.
aj: thanks — is this a full freeze or soft?
maria: soft freeze. No new merge commits to main->prod pipelines. Hotpatches allowed with release-ops approval.
celine: can you add the exact throttle rules? want to adjust autoscaler thresholds for session-worker.
maria: doing that now. Rule: reduce canary traffic to 20%, apply latency throttle token-bucket to inference routes (model/*) to cap p95 token timeouts.
release-bot: Canary controller: v3.9.2 -> paused on shard A. Auto-rollback armed if error-rate > 1.5% for 5 minutes.
jason-oncall: I'll watch logs and escalate if we see queue depth > 2000. Ping me if any rollout requires exception.
aj: quick note — telemetry shows KV-cache eviction spikes around 2026-03-22T02:10Z, probable impact on short-seq requests. I'm running a targeted canary with KV-prefetch disabled.
maria: good. If that stabilizes p50/p95, we'll relax throttle. If not, we'll widen quiet window.
celine: added the exception form link in the thread: https://internal/release-ops/exceptions — include justification + rollback plan.
jason-oncall: for visibility, running `kubectl get pods -n canary -l app=runtime -o wide` and tailing logs for the top 3 pods.
aj: logs show repeated `KVCacheEvict` from node-7; will collect heap profile and post.
maria: please coordinate with eng-runtime for a hotpatch if heap leak confirmed. Otherwise we'll move canary traffic to shard B.
release-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled rollouts blocked until quiet-window ends or release-ops overrides.
celine: tagging infra and runtime leads: @aj @jason-oncall — can you confirm sprint hotpatch capacity?
jason-oncall: we have one on-call slot free, infra can pick this up. I'll take first response.
maria: final notes: 1) soft-freeze for 3 hours; 2) throttle to 20% canary traffic + token-bucket applied; 3) auto-rollback thresholds unchanged; 4) exceptions via the form only. I'll post a follow-up when we either lift or extend. :thumbsup:
aj: copy, standing by.
celine: thanks — collecting heap profiles now, will post within 20m.
release-bot: Incident-tracker: ticket #IR-2026-142 created and linked to canary events.
